description: Lines a bill's paper carries beside its text, worded from the bill's own records: the warning the body's lawyer gives on a power the authority row marks disputed (governing phase B, gov-m3-01-city-attorney-warning-on-the-bill). Said of the body, never of the player, so it fits any bill.

slots.lawyer: The body's lawyer by the title the records give, in lower case: city attorney, county attorney, town counsel.
slots.body: The body that would pass the bill, as the paper names it: the council, the board.

parts.text: The {lawyer} warns that the {body} may not have the power to do this.
parts.author: Words session

parts.text: The {body}'s lawyer warns that it may not have the power to do this.
parts.author: Words session
